source: Actual repository model, redaction and dashboard presenter modules; native TypeScript stripping; one extensionless import resolved to its actual .ts file

checks.name: Aggregate adds USD and EUR minor units without a support currency
Recurring monthly field adds receipts from separate months
Stored zero current funding overrides a settled receipt sum
Over-goal numeric percentage is capped at 100 before presentation
Missing goal/funding values become an unqualified numeric zero summary
Partial refund fact is unused while full-refunded status excludes the row
A gift whose donor is absent from loaded donor rows retains donorId
Missing currency defaults to USD and JPY is divided by 100
Portal recognizes succeeded and success as settled statuses

limits: Checks assert observed current behavior, including defects; they do not certify desired financial semantics
No API, database, browser, React hook, JSX formatter, authorization, notification or provider pipeline executed
The extra refund_amount fixture is intentionally ignored by the current model, matching the separate static finding that its query does not select refund facts
Currency fixtures prove helper behavior, not that these values were observed in live production data
